I turn messy data into decisions companies actually act on: churn models that flag which retention program pays for itself, uplift models that find who a campaign really moves, dashboards that tell a distributor where to source next. Python, SQL, and Tableau are the tools; the CLV math and the business case are the point.

<section id="about" class="home-section reveal">
  <h2 class="art-section-label home-section-label">About</h2>

  <div class="now-strip">
    <span class="now-strip-dot"></span>
    <span><strong>Right now:</strong> wrapping up a Merchandising Analyst internship at PlanetArt and finishing my MSBA capstone at UC San Diego (Dec 2026 grad), open to full-time analyst and PM roles.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="about-stats">
    <div class="about-stat">
      <span class="about-stat-num">5</span>
      <span class="about-stat-label">Analytics &amp; Strategy Roles</span>
    </div>
    <div class="about-stat">
      <span class="about-stat-num">11</span>
      <span class="about-stat-label">Portfolio Projects</span>
    </div>
    <div class="about-stat">
      <span class="about-stat-num">3</span>
      <span class="about-stat-label">Degrees: UCSD, UPenn, UC Denver</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <p class="about-copy">
    I've had different titles for my work, analyst, ops, product, but it's
    the same job every time: figure out where a process is really breaking,
    engineer the fix, and get a team to actually use it.
  </p>
  <p class="about-copy">
    At Thermo Fisher Scientific, I reengineered a customer experience
    scoring system that teams didn't trust enough to act on. The model was
    never the difficult part. The stakeholder work to get frontline teams to
    believe the score and change what they did because of it took as much
    effort as the data work. At a B2B AI agent startup, I automated the
    workflows behind customer conversations so reps could stop wasting time
    on manual busywork between calls. When I joined PlanetArt, I built
    vendor and competitive intelligence tools so merchandising teams could
    read their own market rather than waiting for me to run the numbers
    each week.
  </p>
  <p class="about-copy">
    The hand-off is my favorite moment, when something I've built stops
    being my project and just becomes how the team works. I use Python,
    SQL, and AI agent tools like Claude Code to get there faster, but the
    real work is in figuring out what is worth building, and then proving
    that it earned its place.
  </p>
</section>

<script>
function openTestimonialModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeTestimonialModal(event, id) {
  const modal = document.getElementById(id);
  if (event.target === modal || event.target.classList.contains('testimonial-modal-close')) {
    modal.classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }
}
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.testimonial-modal.active').forEach(m => {
      m.classList.remove('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  }
});
</script>

<script>
function sendContactEmail(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  const subject = document.getElementById('contact-subject').value;
  const message = document.getElementById('contact-message').value;
  const to = 'zhangyafeijudy@gmail.com';
  window.location.href = 'mailto:' + to
    + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(subject)
    + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(message);
  return false;
}
</script>

    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('reveal-visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.12 });
  revealEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
})();
</script>

  const closeBtn = proofBox.querySelector('.skill-proof-close');
  const pills = document.querySelectorAll('.skill-pill');

  function closeProof() {
    proofBox.hidden = true;
    pills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  }

  function openProof(skill, pill) {
    const data = SKILL_PROOF[skill];
    proofLabel.textContent = skill;
    proofList.innerHTML = '';
    if (Array.isArray(data)) {
      data.forEach(item => {
        const li = document.createElement('li');
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = item.href;
        a.textContent = item.title;
        li.appendChild(a);
        proofList.appendChild(li);
      });
    } else {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      li.textContent = data || "Applied in professional work; not yet tied to a specific project on this site.";
      li.style.cssText = 'color:#8a8a8a; font-family:"Jost",sans-serif; font-size:0.92rem; line-height:1.6; padding:0.3rem 0;';
      proofList.appendChild(li);
    }
    proofBox.hidden = false;
    pills.forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', p === pill));
    proofBox.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
  }

  pills.forEach(pill => {
    pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const skill = pill.dataset.skill;
      if (pill.classList.contains('active')) {
        closeProof();
      } else {
        openProof(skill, pill);
      }
    });
  });

  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeProof);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('bg-canvas');
  if (!wrap) return;
  const blobs = Array.from(wrap.querySelectorAll('.aurora-blob'));
  const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  // Per-blob drift character: speed/phase for ambient motion, drift/parallax
  // amplitudes in px. Kept gentle so it reads as "breathing," not busy.
  const cfg = [
    { speed: 0.18, phase: 0,   driftAmp: 34, parallax: 22 },
    { speed: 0.14, phase: 2.1, driftAmp: 40, parallax: -28 },
    { speed: 0.11, phase: 4.3, driftAmp: 30, parallax: 18 },
    { speed: 0.16, phase: 1.2, driftAmp: 26, parallax: -16 }
  ];

  const mouse = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 };
  let targetMouse = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 };

  function updateVisibility() {
    // A fixed-position layer can bleed through later sections on some
    // browsers regardless of z-index, so hide it outright once scrolled
    // past the hero instead of relying on stacking order.
    wrap.style.display = window.scrollY < window.innerHeight * 0.9 ? '' : 'none';
  }

  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    targetMouse.x = e.clientX / window.innerWidth;
    targetMouse.y = e.clientY / window.innerHeight;
  });
  window.addEventListener('scroll', updateVisibility, { passive: true });
  updateVisibility();

  if (prefersReducedMotion) {
    return; // Leave blobs in their static CSS-defined positions.
  }

  function frame(t) {
    const time = t / 1000;
    // Ease the tracked mouse position toward the real one for a soft,
    // trailing feel rather than snapping straight to the cursor.
    mouse.x += (targetMouse.x - mouse.x) * 0.03;
    mouse.y += (targetMouse.y - mouse.y) * 0.03;

    blobs.forEach((el, i) => {
      const c = cfg[i % cfg.length];
      const driftX = Math.sin(time * c.speed + c.phase) * c.driftAmp;
      const driftY = Math.cos(time * c.speed * 0.8 + c.phase) * c.driftAmp;
      const parallaxX = (mouse.x - 0.5) * c.parallax;
      const parallaxY = (mouse.y - 0.5) * c.parallax;
      el.style.transform = `translate(${(driftX + parallaxX).toFixed(1)}px, ${(driftY + parallaxY).toFixed(1)}px)`;
    });

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
